WITH base_pop AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS patient_id
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
    WHERE baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate
      AND baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate
  ) a
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
    WHERE cd4 < 200
      AND encounter_date >= :startDate
      AND encounter_date < :endDate

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
    WHERE baseline_cd4 < 200
      AND encounter_datetime >= :startDate
      AND encounter_datetime < :endDate
  ) qualifying
    ON qualifying.client_id = a.client_id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM person p
    WHERE p.person_id = a.client_id
      AND p.dead = 1
      AND p.death_date <= :endDate
  )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_transfer_in mfti
      WHERE mfti.client_id = a.client_id
    )
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'MOH_105_OPD_DIAG'
    AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    mdp.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.patient_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = base_pop.patient_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IN ('F', 'M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender AS gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
  ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
 AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;
